musicDirector.combat: keep: the remake has no combat music (chapter1.md 16 lists none). A fight keeps whatever plays (the lute, the dirge, the drones, a silence); the encounters below get stingers instead. While the core still switches state, zoneTracks maps the combat state to the explore track (the manifest's zoneOverrides carry it): UAbyssAudioSystem treats a zone-overridden request that resolves to the track already sounding as a no-op even with restart = true (U7), so the combat edge never restarts the drones
